item.title: Hiking Permits Could Be Coming to Southern California’s Mount Baldy
item.description: After the deaths of three hikers on the slopes of Mount Baldy, calls are growing to regulate use of the popular Southern California mountain.

item.title: Dozens of Skiers Trapped on Lift in French Alps
item.description: Dozens of skiers were trapped on a lift in a resort in the French Alps, with some having to be winched to safety by rescue helicopters.

item.title: Kala Desoto Wins Da Hui Backdoor Shootout as Organizers Alter Event Format
item.description: Eighteen-year-old Kala Desoto won the 2026 Da Hui Backdoor Shootout as organizers were forced to alter the event's format because of conditions.

item.title: 12-Year-Old ‘Completely Unresponsive’ After Shark Attack
item.description: Nico Antic was one of four shark attack victims this week in New South Wales, Australia. Friends and family recently provided updates on his condition.

item.title: Surfing Heroes Describe the Harrowing Rescue of Shark Attack Victim Andre de Ruyter
item.description: When Ash Bowler and Eduardo Botti paddled out at North Steyne near Manly Beach, they expected the usual afternoon surf session. They became heroes instead.

item.title: We Spoke With Lyndie Irons About Andy’s Enduring Legacy
item.description: Andy Irons is, without question, a surfing icon. His legacy lives on through his wife Lyndie and son Axel. We recently spoke with Lyndie about Andy's legacy.

item.title: A Giant Fatberg Was Behind the Poo Balls That Washed Ashore on Sydney Beaches
item.description: If you've stepped on tar balls on beaches in the Sydney area, they might not have been tar balls. They might've been poo balls. Poo balls from a fatberg.

item.title: California Beach Town Warns of Car Thieves Targeting Surfers (Again)
item.description: According to law enforcement, one California beach town has seen an uptick of car thefts among surfers recently. The don't want to see it become a trend.

item.title: Inside the Mind of Donald Brink and His Weird Surfboards
item.description: Donald Brink is an exceedingly interesting man. He does not make normal surfboards, but the surfboards he makes are functional works of art. Weird art, but art.

item.title: Helicopter Crashes in Wasatch County, Utah as Passengers, Onlookers Film
item.description: Four people were involved in a helicopter crash in Utah. The aircraft spun out of control and landed in a forest near Timber Lakes in Wasatch County.
